newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Utilities to buy gas company.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Utilities to buy gas company.

text.p: Chesapeake Utilities Corp said on Friday that it has agreed to acquire Tri-County Gas Co Inc, a propane distribution business in Maryland, for 639,000 shares of common stock.
After the deal, Chesapeake will have about 4.4 million shares outstanding, it said.
Excluding one time merger costs, Chesapeake said the deal will immediately help its earnings per share. The deal is expected to close by March 31, 1997, the company said.
Chesapeake said the combined companies will serve 32,000 propane customers and had delivered 30 million retail and wholesale gallons of propane during 1996.
Chesapeake also provides natural gas to 35,000 customers in certain sections of Delaware, Maryland and Florida.
